source_text_original: Assosa, around the city administration office Ethiopian national election board Bensahangul Gumuze,Ethiopia Tel: 0577750598 … We provide free legal advice and representation to all women and girls, ensuring equitable access to justice across both development and crisis-affected environments.

name_am: አሶሳ ሆስፒታል – የተቀናጀ አገልግሎት ማዕከል (One-Stop Centre)
source_name: UNFPA Ethiopia — "Canada's support strengthens protection and economic opportunities for women in Benishangul-Gumuz" (13 March 2026)
source_text_original: At the Assosa Hospital One Stop Center for survivors of gender-based violence (GBV), women and girls can access police, justice, health and psychosocial services in one location. This integrated approach ensures that survivors receive immediate protection, care and support without having to navigate multiple institutions.
notes_en: Police and justice services are on site. Phone, hours and cost are not stated.
notes_am: የፖሊስና የፍትሕ አገልግሎቶች በቦታው አሉ። ስልክ፣ የሥራ ሰዓትና ዋጋ አልተገለጹም።
